scope: Only native cells marked accepted. No R3 cell is silently added. Complete amplitude or global norm follows only if every physical source cell is covered.
proof: On each rectangular cell one certified native frame is chosen. Its positive source chord is convex in kappa and affine in shape; the r quadratic is maximized exactly and outer-u quadratic at both endpoints. Physical r is restricted only by the accepted R_rho bridge, evaluated outward at the lower u endpoint.
